changeSet.createView: WITH tx_base AS ( SELECT h.client_token AS client, (substr(h.business_date,1,4)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,5,2)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,7,2))::DATE AS process_date, t.arrival_id, t.sequence, t.e2e, t.debtor_account, t.debtor_name, t.creditor_account, t.currency, t.amount, v.outcome AS ctv_outcome, v.detail AS ctv_detail, v.created_at AS validated_at, h.created_at AS ingested_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h.client_token, t.e2e ORDER BY h.created_at, t.arrival_id, t.sequence) > 1 AS is_resubmission FROM public.tx_entry t JOIN public.tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = t.arrival_id LEFT JOIN public.validation_log v ON v.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND v.sequence = t.sequence ), member_emission AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.arrival_id, m.sequence, m.e2e) e.arrival_id, m.sequence, m.e2e, e.id AS emission_id FROM public.crw_emission_member m JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = m.emission_id ORDER BY e.arrival_id, m.sequence, m.e2e, e.run_date DESC, e.batch_ordinal DESC ), isr_pick AS ( SELECT u.emission_id, u.e2e, u.status, u.reason, u.created_at FROM (SELECT c.emission_id, c.e2e, c.status, c.reason, c.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.emission_id, c.e2e ORDER BY c.resolved DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.response_file DESC) AS pick_rank FROM (SELECT r.emission_id, r.e2e, r.status, r.reason, true AS resolved, r.created_at, r.response_file FROM public.isr_resp r WHERE r.emission_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT em.id, r.e2e, r.status, r.reason, false, r.created_at, r.response_file FROM public.isr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission em ON em.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id WHERE r.emission_id IS NULL) c) u WHERE u.pick_rank = 1 ), sbsr_pick AS ( SELECT u.emission_id, u.e2e, u.status, u.reason, u.created_at FROM (SELECT c.emission_id, c.e2e, c.status, c.reason, c.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.emission_id, c.e2e ORDER BY c.resolved DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.response_file DESC) AS pick_rank FROM (SELECT r.emission_id, r.e2e, r.status, r.reason, true AS resolved, r.created_at, r.response_file FROM public.sbsr_resp r WHERE r.emission_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT em.id, r.e2e, r.status, r.reason, false, r.created_at, r.response_file FROM public.sbsr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission em ON em.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id WHERE r.emission_id IS NULL) c) u WHERE u.pick_rank = 1 ), pbsr_pick AS ( SELECT u.emission_id, u.e2e, u.status, u.reason, u.created_at FROM (SELECT c.emission_id, c.e2e, c.status, c.reason, c.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.emission_id, c.e2e ORDER BY c.resolved DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.response_file DESC) AS pick_rank FROM (SELECT r.emission_id, r.e2e, r.status, r.reason, true AS resolved, r.created_at, r.response_file FROM public.pbsr_resp r WHERE r.emission_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT em.id, r.e2e, r.status, r.reason, false, r.created_at, r.response_file FROM public.pbsr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission em ON em.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id WHERE r.emission_id IS NULL) c) u WHERE u.pick_rank = 1 ) SELECT x.client, x.process_date, x.arrival_id, x.sequence, x.e2e, x.debtor_account, x.debtor_name, x.creditor_account, x.currency, x.amount, COALESCE(pp.status, sp.status, ip.status, CASE WHEN x.ctv_outcome = 'PASS' THEN 'CTV_PASS' ELSE x.ctv_outcome END) AS status, x.ctv_outcome, x.ctv_detail, x.validated_at, pp.status::VARCHAR(8) AS pbsr_status, pp.reason::VARCHAR(8) AS pbsr_reason, x.ingested_at, pp.created_at AS settled_at, CASE WHEN pp.status IS NOT NULL THEN 'PBSR' WHEN sp.status IS NOT NULL THEN 'SBSR' WHEN ip.status IS NOT NULL THEN 'ISR' END AS resp_stage, CASE WHEN pp.status IS NOT NULL THEN pp.reason WHEN sp.status IS NOT NULL THEN sp.reason ELSE ip.reason END AS resp_reason, CASE WHEN pp.status IS NOT NULL THEN pp.created_at WHEN sp.status IS NOT NULL THEN sp.created_at ELSE ip.created_at END AS resp_detected_at, me.emission_id IS NOT NULL AS emitted, x.is_resubmission FROM tx_base x LEFT JOIN member_emission me ON me.arrival_id = x.arrival_id AND me.sequence = x.sequence AND me.e2e = x.e2e LEFT JOIN isr_pick ip ON ip.emission_id = me.emission_id AND ip.e2e = x.e2e LEFT JOIN sbsr_pick sp ON sp.emission_id = me.emission_id AND sp.e2e = x.e2e LEFT JOIN pbsr_pick pp ON pp.emission_id = me.emission_id AND pp.e2e = x.e2e WHERE x.client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal'

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, count(*) AS tx_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('ACSC', 'ACCC')) AS settled_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('ACSC', 'ACCC')), 0) AS settled_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('RJCT', 'CANC')) AS rejected_late_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('RJCT', 'CANC')), 0) AS rejected_late_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ctv_outcome LIKE 'FAIL%') AS rejected_early_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE ctv_outcome LIKE 'FAIL%'), 0) AS rejected_early_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_resubmission) AS resubmission_count, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount::FLOAT8)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS p50_amount, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount::FLOAT8)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS p95_amount, stddev(amount) AS stddev_amount FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, process_date

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, 'CTV' AS stage, ctv_outcome AS reason, e2e, debtor_account, amount, ingested_at AS submitted_at, validated_at AS detected_at FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE ctv_outcome LIKE 'FAIL%' AND (client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal') UNION ALL SELECT client, process_date, resp_stage AS stage, resp_reason AS reason, e2e, debtor_account, amount, ingested_at AS submitted_at, resp_detected_at AS detected_at FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE resp_stage IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('RJCT', 'CANC') AND (client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, stage, reason, count(*) AS fail_count, sum(amount) AS fail_amount FROM rpt.v_fails WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, process_date, stage, reason

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, debtor_account, process_date, count(*) AS tx_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('ACSC', 'ACCC')) AS settled_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('RJCT', 'CANC') OR ctv_outcome LIKE 'FAIL%') AS failed_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('RJCT', 'CANC') OR ctv_outcome LIKE 'FAIL%'), 0) AS failed_amount FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, debtor_account, process_date

changeSet.author: dcre
